Right now, I’m exploring **Electronics and Hardware** and building my skills in **C++, Arduino and Hardware**. Outside the classroom, you can usually find me **Working out or Cooking**.

Take a look at my recent work on the **Projects** page, or feel free to reach out—I’d love to connect!
